title: The Ctrl bar pushes each pane's contents down a row
body:
Jack's design for the Ctrl bar is that it is drawn over the top row of each pane and moves nothing. As of 2026-11-06 it pushes each pane's contents down a row.

`Layout::client_rect` in `src/panes.rs` takes the bar row out of the client's rect while `layout.bar` is set, and `show_bar` in `src/compositor.rs` calls `relayout`, which reconfigures every client one row shorter. `Layout::draw` paints the bars into the chrome grid. `render` pushes the chrome texture last in the element list, and smithay draws the first element on top, so the chrome sits under the clients.

## Proposal

- `client_rect` ignores the bar. `show_bar` requests a redraw and reconfigures nothing.
- `Layout::draw` stops painting the bars. A new `Layout::draw_bars` paints them into a transparent full-window grid, as `overlay_grid` does for the palette.
- `render` rasterizes that grid into a bar texture and pushes it ahead of the pane surfaces. The texture is kept until the layout or the bar state changes.
